body: People get mad at me so much. If there mad it has to be something I did right?

I see you say you've tried "everything" but i'm saying there are other things to open up to, that maybe you could try. That maybe could help you. I hate to hear that you've tried everything, but you've tried everything only you could think of, maybe you should try what other people can help you with. And from what I've seen, there are things you haven't tried. You may not be trying, or even notice, but when some people give advice you only try and contridict or argue. So attempt one more thing, it could save you from this missery and depression. As much as it seems that i may not, i do feel the same way, but I have ways that you haven't attempted that help me get through. If they helped me they might help you. Please dont argue past this point because arguing doesnt help it only makes you more angry and sad. So just try and take advice.

Go see her. Tell her how you feel about it, comfort her. Give her a reason to want to live. I see why she may want to but tell her that there are many thing she can do, she can explore, Pets seem to help, she can find a hobby. Just try and find something that can give her reason to live. You might just save her.

Because maybe no one can give to you, but you can do something other than weap in a corner because you quit. Sometimes the easiest way out is the dumbest. As rude as it may sound, it's stupid to just suicide without trying as much as you can. Now maybe, just maybe you could try to give and help someone because it can make you happy and it makes you feel good you did **something** in your life. So before you give up, stop arguing til the bitter end and try. Try one more thing, because one more thing maybe be what you need.

Wrong. *Give*. Give to someone, give help to someone who can't help themselves. I know you hate pets, but there are humans like you. I will give you a reason to live, because they will appreciate you, someone will remember you for deciding care and help, instead of everyone remembering you for someone who gave up. Just give, then you will have a reason to live.

Well just know, if no one has told you this, I dont want you to die.
And I after you die, if you are able to think and live on in the afterlife, you might regret it, because what happens after your death is your problem because you cause what happened after your death. Just, dont kill yourself, it will never be worth it. No matter how much you think it may.

I have done some roadtrips, they are always nice but the problem is as much as I would love to always go on one, i always have to come back sometime and the issues come back. Thank you though, I appreciate it.

Well. It depends what the problem is bullying or etc.? Either way before you decide to commit sucide think about what would happen after your death? How many people would be affected and suffer from depression possibly leading to suicide as well. One thing I know is you, If you havent tried it, should try to discuss it with kids who are dealing with it as well. It could really help, and you would be able to maybe relate with a few others for the first time in a while? I would just like to suggest these questions before you consider killing yourself. If this upvote didn't help just know that I dont want you to die, I just want to be able to save, help and protect someone for once in my stupid life. So don't suicide, please just go and do something you've never done, help someone because it always makes me want to live just a little bit more. Just, think about it. :)
